description:
Cast Desperate Ritual for {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song for {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Ill-Gotten Gains for {2}{B}{B} and hold priority.
Cast Fork for {R}{R}, copying Ill-Gotten Gains.
Resolve the copied Ill-Gotten Gains, discarding your hand and then returning Desperate Ritual, Seething Song, and Fork to your hand.
Cast Desperate Ritual for {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song for {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
